explanation: No clear trigger. About half of the strong excerpts are the last token of an equation right before '\implies' / '\Rightarrow' or the equation's end ('= 0 \Rightarrow', '= 1 \implies', '(x-8) \implies'); the rest (word-initial 'Th', 'is', 'emitting', '-th', whitespace) and all moderate excerpts are unrelated.
